bread.name: Country Sourdough
bread.desc: Our signature country loaf, fermented for over 18 hours with sourdough starter. Crafted with Japanese bread flour and German rye flour for a crisp crust, highly hydrated crumb, and a subtle delicate acidity.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: Chocolate Sourdough
bread.desc: Rich dark chocolate and cocoa powder folded into long-fermented dough. Melts slightly during baking for a smooth, indulgent chocolate flavor perfectly balanced with gentle sourdough.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, dark chocolate, cocoa powder, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.
bread.allergens: Gluten (Wheat, Rye), Milk, Soy (from dark chocolate)

bread.name: Lemon Blueberry Sourdough
bread.desc: Bursting with tart wild dried blueberries and fragrant fresh lemon zest. A refreshing, fruity sourdough with bright citrus aroma in every bite.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, wild dried blueberries, fresh lemon zest, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: Classic Walnut Raisin Sourdough
bread.desc: Packed with crunchy toasted walnuts and sweet sun-dried raisins. Offers a rich contrast of nutty aromas and natural fruit sweetness.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, toasted walnuts, sun-dried raisins, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: Coffee Chocolate Sourdough
bread.desc: Infused with espresso coffee dough, rich dark chocolate chips, and toasted walnuts. Bold roasted coffee notes harmonized with sweet chocolate and nutty warmth.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, espresso coffee, dark chocolate chips, toasted walnuts, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.
bread.allergens: Gluten (Wheat, Rye), Tree Nuts (Walnuts), Milk, Soy

bread.name: Matcha Cranberry Sourdough
bread.desc: Earthy premium matcha paired with sweet-tart dried cranberries. Vibrant in tea aroma with a beautifully balanced, bittersweet flavor.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, premium matcha powder, dried cranberries, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: Highland Barley Walnut Sourdough
bread.desc: Made with nutritious Tibetan highland barley flour, toasted walnuts, and crunchy pumpkin seeds. Wholesome and earthy with rich grain textures and wonderful chewiness.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, Tibetan highland barley flour, toasted walnuts, crunchy pumpkin seeds, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.
bread.allergens: Gluten (Wheat, Barley), Tree Nuts (Walnuts), Seeds (Pumpkin seeds)

bread.name: Earl Grey Orange & Cranberry Sourdough
bread.desc: Infused with fragrant Earl Grey tea dough, candied orange zest, and dried cranberries. Elegant citrus and bergamot notes merged with warm tea aroma.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, Earl Grey tea powder, candied orange zest, dried cranberries, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: Dragon Fruit Cream Cheese Sourdough
bread.desc: Made with fresh red dragon fruit for a striking natural pink dough, filled with rich and velvety cream cheese pockets.
bread.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, fresh red dragon fruit, cream cheese filling, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

cake.name: Amber Caramel Double Fromage Cheesecake
cake.desc: An exquisite 4-inch double-layer cheesecake creation. A heavenly double-layer creation featuring a velvety mascarpone mousse on top, a rich baked cheesecake in the middle, and a crispy caramelized cookie base. A melt-in-your-mouth indulgence infused with warm amber caramel notes.
cake.ingredients: Mascarpone cheese, sour cream, cream cheese, caramel biscuit crust, fresh cream, eggs, sugar, butter.

cake.name: Matcha Oreo Double Fromage Cheesecake
cake.desc: An exquisite 4-inch double-layer cheesecake creation. Built on a crunchy Oreo cookie base, centered with a rich baked original cheesecake, and crowned with a silky matcha mascarpone mousse. A beautiful harmony of cocoa, creaminess, and tea notes.
cake.ingredients: Mascarpone cheese, Oreo cookie crust, premium matcha powder, cream cheese, fresh cream, eggs, sugar, butter.

archived.name: Honey Pumpkin & Seed Sourdough
archived.desc: A cozy blend of real pumpkin puree, pure honey, roasted pumpkin cubes, and toasted pumpkin seeds. Tender, naturally sweet crumb with crunchy seeds.
archived.ingredients: Japanese high-protein bread flour, German rye flour, fresh pumpkin puree, pure honey, roasted pumpkin cubes, crunchy pumpkin seeds, water, sourdough starter, rose salt.

bread.name: 乡村欧包
bread.desc: 麦日记的招牌经典之作。只使用面粉、水、盐和酸种酵母。历经18小时以上的低温慢发酵，外壳酥脆，内里组织湿润弹牙，带有纯粹的麦香与微酸回甘。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。

bread.name: 巧克力欧包
bread.desc: 选用浓郁的黑巧克力融入面团。经过烘烤后巧克力微微融化，带给面包丝滑口感与丰富的可可层次，甜而不腻，满足感十足。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、黑巧克力、可可粉、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
bread.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、裸麦）、乳制品、大豆成分（来自黑巧克力）。

bread.name: 柠檬蓝莓欧包
bread.desc: 清爽的鲜磨柠檬皮屑与多汁的蓝莓干完美结合。酸甜果香在舌尖绽放，入口带着天然果酸与柠檬清香，是下午茶的绝佳选择。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、野生蓝莓干、新鲜鲜磨柠檬皮屑、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。

bread.name: 经典葡萄核桃欧包
bread.desc: 香脆的烤核桃搭配日晒甘甜的葡萄干。坚果的醇香与果干的自然酸甜交织，咀嚼间充满饱满的层次感，是广受欢迎的经典口味。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、烤核桃仁、日晒葡萄干、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
bread.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、裸麦）、树坚果（核桃）。

bread.name: 咖啡巧克力欧包
bread.desc: 浓郁咖啡风味与黑巧克力块、香脆核桃仁的浪漫碰撞。醇厚的咖啡苦香烘托出巧克力的甜美与核桃油脂香，回味悠长，唤醒每一个慵懒的早晨。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、浓缩咖啡液、黑巧克力粒、烤核桃仁、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
bread.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、裸麦）、树坚果（核桃）、乳制品、大豆成分。

bread.name: 抹茶蔓越莓欧包
bread.desc: 严选优质抹茶粉，呈现幽雅的自然茶绿。搭配酸甜可口的蔓越莓干，抹茶的微苦与果干的甘甜互补，茶香余韵悠线。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、优质抹茶粉、蔓越莓干、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。

bread.name: 青稞核桃欧包
bread.desc: 融入营养丰富的西藏青稞粉、烤核桃粒与香脆南瓜籽。青稞特有的谷物香气与坚果油脂香、南瓜籽交织，越嚼越香，健康更有嚼劲。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、中国西藏青稞粉、烤核桃仁、香脆南瓜籽、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
bread.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、青稞）、树坚果（核桃）、种子类（南瓜籽）。

bread.name: 红茶橙皮欧包
bread.desc: 伯爵红茶粉揉面，搭配糖渍橙皮皮屑与蔓越莓干。佛手柑茶香温润，橙皮清甜与蔓越莓酸甜交织，雅致韵味十足。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、伯爵红茶粉、糖渍橙皮皮屑、蔓越莓干、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。

bread.name: 火龙果奶酪欧包
bread.desc: 纯红肉火龙果榨汁揉面，呈现梦幻的天然粉红色。包裹着浓郁绵密的奶油奶酪夹心，果香与奶香交织，颜值与美味兼备。
bread.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、新鲜红肉火龙果、奶油奶酪夹心、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
bread.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、裸麦）、乳制品（奶油奶酪）。

cake.name: 琥珀焦糖双层芝士蛋糕
cake.desc: 精巧4寸双层芝士蛋糕。底座是香脆的焦糖饼干，中层是浓郁醇厚的原味烘焙芝士，顶层则是如云朵般轻盈的生乳酪慕斯。温暖焦香与丝滑奶香完美交织，带来层次丰富、入口即化的奢华体验。
cake.ingredients: 马斯卡彭乳酪、酸奶油、奶油芝士、焦糖饼干底、新鲜奶油、鸡蛋、砂糖、黄油。
cake.allergens: 含有乳制品（奶油、奶酪）、鸡蛋、麸质（小麦/焦糖饼干底）、大豆成分。

cake.name: 抹茶奥利奥双层芝士蛋糕
cake.desc: 精巧4寸双层芝士蛋糕。底座是香浓酥脆奥利奥饼干底，中层是浓郁醇厚原味烘烤芝士，顶层是丝滑优雅的抹茶马斯卡彭慕斯。奥利奥的微甜、芝士的浓香与抹茶的茶韵交织，层次丰富无比。
cake.ingredients: 马斯卡彭乳酪、奥利奥饼干底、优质抹茶粉、奶油芝士、新鲜奶油、鸡蛋、砂糖、黄油。
cake.allergens: 含有乳制品（奶油、奶酪）、鸡蛋、麸质（小麦/奥利奥饼干）、大豆成分。

archived.name: 蜂蜜金瓜南瓜籽欧包
archived.desc: 融入纯正蜂蜜与新鲜南瓜泥，包裹着绵软的烤南瓜丁，撒满香脆南瓜籽。天然甜香与多重南瓜层次交织，口感软糯香脆。
archived.ingredients: 日本高筋小麦粉、德国裸麦粉、新鲜南瓜泥、纯正蜂蜜、烤南瓜丁、香脆南瓜籽、水、酸种酵母、玫瑰盐。
archived.allergens: 含有麸质（小麦、裸麦）、种子类（南瓜籽）。
archived.archived_note: 正式下架（老板 2026-08-19 决定）
